data.display_address: Kempinski Palm Residence, The Crescent, Palm Jumeirah, Dubai
data.long_description:
A Signature Villa at Kempinski Residences
 
 Where luxury becomes personal
 
 This rare 4 storey signature villa is more than just a residence, it is a true lifestyle statement in one of Dubai’s most iconic beachfront destinations. Located within the exclusive Kempinski Residences, it offers exceptional privacy, timeless elegance, and panoramic views across the sea and skyline.
 
 Thoughtfully designed across four levels including a rooftop and basement, the villa combines space, comfort, and sophistication. The interiors are fully furnished with high end designer finishes, creating a seamless move in experience.
 The property features 5 spacious ensuite bedrooms, each with its own terrace and abundant natural light, ensuring both privacy and comfort. The layout also includes a home cinema, meeting room, private gym, entertainment lounge, as well as dedicated maid’s and driver’s rooms. 
 The private rooftop is a standout feature, offering a personal sanctuary complete with a swimming pool, jacuzzi, and stunning coastal views, ideal for relaxation or entertaining.
 
 Property Highlights
 
 5 ensuite bedrooms
 8 bathrooms with premium finishes
 Fully furnished with designer interiors
 Private rooftop with swimming pool and jacuzzi
 Home cinema, gym, and entertainment areas
 Meeting room
 Maid’s room and driver’s room
 Basement with 2 private parking spaces and storage
 
 Residents enjoy full access to world class resort amenities including fine dining outlets, spa facilities, gym, concierge services, and direct private beach access.
 
 
 This villa stands out for its scale, layout, and the way it seamlessly blends privacy, luxury, and resort style living, making it a perfect choice for those seeking an exclusive beachfront lifestyle.
